analytic_candidate.method: Use nearby dyadic barycentrics (w,u,v); cubic z=-0.12*w*u*v from original control111.z=-0.02; affine x=u+v,y=1.37*u+0.37*v. Midpoint of endpoint barycentrics gives (0.375,0.375,0.25). Compute scalar restricted Bernstein controls by blossom=-0.02*sum_permutations(a0[i]*a1[j]*a2[k]); subtract the linear chord controls. Weight squared excess above 0.001 by physical twice-area. Compute ordinary binary64 determinant(b-a,c-a,d-a) for captured tets with this approximate realized midpoint substituted for either endpoint.
